# Vertebrate Animals

<!-- Required if the project involves live vertebrate animals. NIH requires
     exactly these three points (the fourth, euthanasia, was folded into the
     others in the 2016 revision — check current instructions). Delete this
     section entirely if no vertebrate animals are involved.
     Note: this attachment does NOT describe IACUC approval status; that is
     handled elsewhere in the application. -->

## 1. Description of Procedures

Species, strains, ages, sex, and total number to be used. Procedures, and how
they relate to the Aims. Justify the numbers.

## 2. Justification

Why animals are required, why this species, and why no non-animal alternative
suffices. Address the 3Rs (replacement, reduction, refinement).

## 3. Minimization of Pain and Distress

Anesthesia, analgesia, and humane endpoints. If a procedure would cause more
than momentary pain and no analgesic is used, justify it scientifically.
Method of euthanasia and its consistency with AVMA guidelines.
